item.scanner:headline: NYDFS clears change of control; DFPI suspends approval extension for IMXI deal
item.description:
NYDFS clears change of control; DFPI suspends approval extension for IMXI deal

Obtained NYDFS approval for the indirect change of control of Intermex's New York-licensed money transmitter subsidiary in connection with its pending acquisition of International Money Express (IMXI). The company also entered into an Assurance of Discontinuance with NYAG and commitments with NYDFS, including maintaining retail footprint and price limits for three years. However, the California DFPI suspended its approval extension, and the companies intend to engage promptly to seek reinstatement and close promptly after.

About: The Western Union Company provides money movement payments, and digital financial services in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Consumer Money Transfer and Consumer Services. The Consumer Money Transfer segment facilitates money transfers for international cross-border and intra-country transfers, primarily through a network of retail agents and owned locations, as well as through websites and mobile devices.

  • Next catalyst: DFPI approval reinstatement
